name: Engineering
summary: Design, build and improve machines, structures, software and systems that people rely on every day.
preparation: Strong Class 11-12 PCM foundation
Daily numerical practice
Attempt previous years' papers from Class 11

name: Medicine
summary: Diagnose, treat and prevent illness, and care for people across their lives.
preparation: Master NCERT Biology line by line
Regular mock tests
Build stamina for long study hours

name: Computer Science
summary: Create software, algorithms and systems, from apps to artificial intelligence.
entranceRoutes: Direct admission on Class 12 marks in some colleges
preparation: Learn one programming language early
Practice problem solving on coding platforms
Keep maths strong, especially discrete maths

name: Data Science
summary: Turn data into decisions using statistics, programming and domain knowledge.
preparation: Get comfortable with probability and statistics
Learn spreadsheets then Python
Work on small data projects

name: Design
summary: Shape how products, spaces and visuals look, feel and work for people.
entranceRoutes: NATA and JEE Paper 2 for architecture
preparation: Build a portfolio of projects
Practice observation and sketching daily
Study how everyday objects are designed

name: Law
summary: Interpret and apply the law to protect rights, resolve disputes and shape policy.
preparation: Read newspapers and editorials daily
Practice logical reasoning and legal aptitude
Join debate and moot court activities

name: Research
summary: Ask new questions and discover knowledge in science, mathematics or social fields.
preparation: Go deeper than the syllabus in one subject
Attempt olympiad problems
Read popular science and research summaries

name: Commerce
summary: Manage money, business and markets, from accounting to entrepreneurship finance.
preparation: Keep arithmetic and algebra sharp
Follow business news
Learn basics of accounting early

name: Defence
summary: Serve in the armed forces with leadership, discipline and technical skills.
preparation: Maintain fitness routines
Practice general knowledge and current affairs
Prepare for SSB interviews with group activities

name: Entrepreneurship
summary: Build products and organisations that solve real problems and create jobs.
entranceRoutes: No fixed entrance; any degree works
preparation: Start a small project or club initiative now
Learn to present ideas clearly
Study how businesses around you work
